categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: automotive parts manufacturing, oil and gas equipment and engineering, and high-performance functional materials. Automotive parts include interior and exterior components, engine lightweight parts, intelligent cockpit components, and molds. Oil and gas equipment focuses on perforating tools and high-end completion equipment for oil and gas wells. High-performance functional materials cover information anti-counterfeiting materials, electronic functional materials, and weather-resistant functional materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages aerospace advanced manufacturing technologies, integrating specialized energy, precision machinery, and electronic control technologies. It employs synchronous R&D and manufacturing capabilities for automotive parts and molds, with core technologies in soft interior materials, lightweight plastics, and intelligent optical-electronic integration. In oil and gas equipment, it has developed cluster perforation systems, electronic detonators, and high-temperature high-pressure completion tools. For functional materials, it uses synthesis, dispersion, coating, and vacuum metallization technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic automotive manufacturers such as Geely, Changan, FAW Group, GAC, Chery, BYD, and new energy vehicle makers like Huawei HarmonyOS and NIO. Oil and gas equipment customers are primarily the three major Chinese oil companies: CNPC, Sinopec, and CNOOC. Functional materials serve electronics, semiconductor, chemical, and automotive industries, with clients including BOE, Tianma Microelectronics, and BYD.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases aligned with major automotive clusters across Northeast, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Central, Southwest, Pearl River Delta, and Yangtze River Delta regions. It also has international market presence in oil and gas equipment and functional materials, exporting products to Asia, Europe, America, and the Middle East. Overseas oil and gas projects and international oilfield service companies are part of its customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain. In automotive, it supplies parts and assemblies directly to OEMs and tier-one suppliers. In oil and gas, it provides upstream equipment for well perforation and completion. In functional materials, it is positioned upstream as a materials supplier for electronics and automotive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 'Aerospace+' and intelligent manufacturing, focusing on innovation in automotive lightweighting, smart cockpits, and integrated optical-electronic technologies. R&D efforts target new perforation technologies, intelligent completion tools, and electronic detonators in oil and gas. Functional materials R&D emphasizes product series expansion, domestic substitution of imported materials, and development of automotive interior films and electronic shielding membranes. The company invests heavily in R&D, with a 20% increase in spending in 2024 and multiple patents granted.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct product sales to automotive OEMs and suppliers, oil and gas companies, and industrial clients for functional materials. The company employs a direct sales model, with some products sold through bidding processes or direct negotiation. It also earns investment income and government subsidies, but the core revenue is from manufacturing and selling physical products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in automotive interior and exterior parts, oil and gas perforating and completion equipment, and high-performance functional materials. It holds a dominant market share in cluster perforation equipment (over 80% domestically) and is recognized as a national manufacturing champion in several product categories. Competitors include other domestic automotive parts manufacturers and oilfield equipment suppliers, but the company leverages aerospace technology and integrated capabilities to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.78 billion, a 32.78% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 791.7 million, up 87.02%. The company’s total assets reached over RMB 10 billion, with steady growth in revenue and profitability driven by expansion in automotive parts and functional materials. R&D investment increased by over 20%, supporting sustained innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes aerospace-grade quality and advanced manufacturing technologies, offering integrated R&D, production, and testing capabilities. Its automotive parts combine lightweight, smart, and environmentally friendly features, supporting intelligent cockpit and new energy vehicle trends. In oil and gas, it provides domestically developed, high-performance perforation and completion tools with high safety and reliability. Functional materials benefit from proprietary core technologies and strong customization capabilities, enabling domestic substitution and enhanced product performance.
